definition: In conflict with something else rather than agreeing or fitting with it.
author: Horace Walpole
quote: But Jerome’s new presumption, so dissonant from his former meekness, suggested still deeper apprehensions.
example_sentence: Her cheerful words were dissonant with her tired face.
